gen-fs-chubbo-gf-gentium-plus: Marker-tip friendly and loose, Chubbo draws smooth curves with no calligraphic swelling anywhere, while Gentium Plus sets a refined classic serif beneath it. They suit each other's moods.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-gowun-batang: Chubbo draws casual, marker-style letters with diagonals as thick as its upright strokes, and Gowun Batang brings a literary classic serif beneath. Playful meets bookish.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-habibi: Habibi reads like a traditional editorial serif, with a clear channel leading into each of its round letters, and Chubbo's flat marker strokes sit above it. The two loosen each other up.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded reads warm and soft, its curves refusing to close and its spacing tight as a thin crack. Press Start 2P brings the retro pixel fun on top, with its slight letterpress-like modulation.
gen-righteous-fs-quicksand: Righteous fills the line with bold bowls, like a thin steel rod bent into every letter, and its fun commanding swagger leads the way. Quicksand follows in rounded, glass-bulb lowercase, so a long passage would feel soft and approachable.
gen-syne-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif speaks with a classic authority, its tall sturdy lowercase shifting mildly from heavy stems to lighter curves. And Syne takes the experimental headline role, curves never thinning, x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cascadia-mono: Almendra Display flaunts ornate letters that never seem to pinch shut. Cascadia Mono then reads in a compact, modern line, its curves as thick as the stems, so a longer stretch feels like neon tubing.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-inika: Inika reads in a classic, traditional serif voice, with a gap you can see through in each s. Chubbo adds its skimming ease from a stroke weight that never changes, and that casual lightness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-audiowide-fs-supreme: Audiowide keeps a level beat, with no accents of weight and tall lowercase set like tiles with wide grout lines. And Supreme carries a longer stretch with a heavy-looking strip of crisp text, letters held open instead of curled shut.
gen-eater-satoshi: Eater is dark and aggressive, with tempered strokes and wide gaps. Satoshi follows with a soaring x-height and a gentle monotone line, so a longer passage would read in an approachable plain sans.
